Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
The Tzimisce Lord wrote:
>
> if i clan impersonate arika to a daughter does she stay camarilla?

No.
When you change clans to a clan of a different sect, you change sects.
Daughters are Independent. [10]

> does she keep her title?

She loses the benefit of the title for as long as she remains non-Cam. [10]

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
"Franck" <ber...@tolbiac.inserm.fr> wrote in message news:2126b308.03010...@posting.google.com...

> That's the eternal problem of changing of clan and changing of sect.
>
> Daughers are independant, so, IMHO, Arika lose her title if she became
> one of them.

Yes, that's correct.

> Does someone can answer clearly to this kind of questions, for example
> :
>
> - What happens if a Malkavian deranges a Sabbat titled vampire ?

The Sabbat title's benefits are lost until/unless that vamp becomes
Sabbat again.

> - What happens if a !Malkavian deranges a Camarilla titled vampire ?

Same as the one before, except in reverse. :-)

> - What happens if a Camarilla titled vampire became Independant (Clan
> Impersonation) ? if he became Sabbat ?

In either case, he loses the benefit of his title until/unless he
becomes Camarilla again.

> - What happens if a Sabbat titled vampire became Independant (Clan
> Impersonation) ? if he became Camarilla ?

Again, in either case, he loses the benefit of his title until/unless
he becomes Sabbat again.

> What is the rule concerning Changing Clan and Changing Sect ???

If you have a Camarilla Edition rulebook, it's all spelled out in
section 10, "Vampire Sects", on p.53. :-)

Note that the printed votes on Independent vampires don't have this
issue, because they're *not* tied to a sect, unlike things like
Bishop, Priscus, Prince, Primogen, and so on. So if Aziz becomes
Camarilla, he still has his printed 2 votes. Same if he becomes
Sabbat. And Genevieve (has 1 additional vote besides being a
Priscus) would keep the additional vote (because it's not from a
sect-based title) if she changed sects, too.

Josh

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>if i clan impersonate arika to a daughter does she stay camarilla?
>does she keep her title?

No. When you change clans, your sect is the default sect of that clan. Thus
when Arika CI's to Daughters of Cacophony, she becomes Independent, thus losing
the benefits of her Camarilla Inner Circle title. If she becomes Camarilla
again (by burning the CI, becoming another clan, gaining a Writ, etc.) she
regains the benefits of her title as long as she did not receive a different
title in the meantime.

Halcyan 2
